newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 8.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on April 8:
WASHINGTON - Commerce Secretary William Daley said he will lead a trade mission to South America next month, his first since taking office.
NEW YORK - Bankers Trust New York Corp said it will buy Baltimore-based Alex Brown Inc, the nation's oldest brokerage.
HANOI, Vietnam - The Vietnamese government pledged to repay the United States $145 million for debts incurred by the former South Vietnam.
WASHINGTON - Alex Brown may have sold out at the perfect time, analysts said.
